title: What Is Liposculpture?
description: What liposculpture (liposuction/body contouring) is, what it involves, what it is for and when it is indicated. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: It reshapes the body contour by removing localized fat and, in liposculpture, re-injecting it to define areas. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
It reshapes the body contour by removing localized fat and, in liposculpture, re-injecting it to define areas.

How is it done?

Fat is suctioned out with cannulas through small incisions; sometimes a fat graft is added.

When is it indicated?

People with localized fat that resists diet and exercise, with a stable weight. The surgeon evaluates this.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team across different clinics, so you can choose the price alternative that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.

faqs.a: It depends on the procedure and the clinic; the specialist will tell you after the evaluation.

faqs.q: Who decides whether I need it?
faqs.a: The surgeon, after an evaluation with tests.

title: Liposculpture: How It Is Done, Step by Step
description: How liposculpture is done step by step: technique, anesthesia and what to expect on the day of surgery.
tldr: Fat is suctioned out with cannulas through small incisions; sometimes a fat graft is added. It is done under general anesthesia or sedation with local anesthesia. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
Before

Tests and evaluation; stable weight; no smoking.

During

Fat is suctioned out with cannulas through small incisions; sometimes a fat graft is added. General anesthesia or sedation with local anesthesia.

After

Compression garment for several weeks; light activities within days; exercise after weeks.

faqs.q: How long does the operation take?
faqs.a: Surgery takes about 1-3 hours depending on the areas; recovery takes 1-3 weeks.
You are operated on under anesthesia; discomfort afterward is managed with medication.

title: Am I a Candidate for Liposculpture?
description: Criteria for being a liposculpture candidate: indications, evaluation and when it is recommended.
keyword: am i a candidate for liposculpture
tldr: Candidates are usually: people with localized fat that resists diet and exercise, with a stable weight. The surgeon evaluates this. Final candidacy is decided by the surgeon after an evaluation with tests.
bodyHtml:
Am I a candidate for liposculpture?

Usual indications

People with localized fat that resists diet and exercise, with a stable weight. The surgeon evaluates this.

The evaluation

It includes your medical history and tests; sometimes imaging. It does not depend only on what the patient wants.

faqs.a: It does not replace weight loss; it is for localized fat, not for obesity.
Your overall health is considered more than age alone.

title: Liposculpture Risks and Complications
description: Risks and possible complications of liposculpture and how they are reduced with evaluation and follow-up.
tldr: Like any surgery, liposculpture has risks: contour irregularities, seroma, changes in sensation and infection. They are uncommon and are reduced with proper evaluation, careful technique and follow-up. The surgeon explains them during the consultation.
bodyHtml:
Learning about the risks of liposculpture is part of a responsible decision.

Possible complications

Contour irregularities, seroma, changes in sensation and infection.

How they are reduced

A complete preoperative evaluation, careful technique and close follow-up. The team's experience influences the results.

faqs.a: It is a common procedure; safety depends on the evaluation, the technique and the follow-up.

faqs.q: What warning signs should I watch for?
faqs.a: Marked swelling or pain, fever, bleeding or signs of infection.
